model_annotation: The plot titled “ViT, ImageNet1k” illustrates how two normalized sharpness composition components evolve over training for a Vision Transformer on ImageNet-1K, shown as two solid lines (blue and orange) without markers. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to about 37,700 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 7,540, 15,080, 22,620, 30,160, and 37,700. The y-axis is labeled “Sharpness composition,” uses a logarithmic scale, and ranges from 10⁻³ up to slightly above 10⁰ (with major ticks at 10⁻³, 10⁻², 10⁻¹, and 10⁰). The blue line begins near 10⁻³ at step 0, rises very steeply within the early steps to near 10⁰ (around ~0.8–1.0), reaches its highest region slightly above 10⁰ (about ~1.0–1.05) around several thousand steps, and then gradually trends downward over the remainder of training, ending below 10⁰ at roughly ~0.75–0.85 by ~37,700 steps. The orange line starts near 10⁰ at step 0 (about ~1.0), drops quickly in the initial steps to around ~0.6–0.7, and then slowly increases over training, approaching just under 10⁰ by the end (about ~0.85–0.95 near ~37,700 steps).
